title: Why You Only Need 1,000 True Fans
text:
In 2008, Wired co-founder Kevin Kelly argued that a creator with 1,000 true fans, each spending $100 a year, earns $100,000. The point: depth of support beats raw reach for a small independent business. It's a rule of thumb, not a promise; costs and results vary.

Follow if you are building something of your own.

Results vary. Not financial or tax advice.

Source: https://kk.org/thetechnium/1000-true-fans/
